hook: Gandhi Hospital's IVF unit records *3* deliveries in a week
hook_b: Gandhi Hospital's IVF unit records *3* deliveries in a week
tldr: The IVF unit at Gandhi Hospital, Secunderabad, recorded three deliveries between Nov 10 and 18: two boys and a girl. The couples came from Warangal, Vikarabad and Yadadri Bhuvanagiri districts.

beats.what: A government hospital's IVF unit recorded three successful deliveries in a week.
beats.why: Private fertility centres in Hyderabad are under scrutiny in an illegal egg trade case.
beats.care: Government IVF gives families an option beyond costly private treatment.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu (Nov 19): one couple had spent about ₹3-4 lakh at private hospitals before.

cards.q: Did you know government hospitals in Hyderabad offer IVF?

qs: How many couples can the government IVF unit take each year?

facts.t: The first couple had struggled with infertility for *16 years* before the Nov 10 birth.

steps.e: Baby girl, couple from Yadadri Bhuvanagiri

viz.verdict: Three families after waits of 9-16 years

learn.t: IVF = in vitro fertilisation, where an egg is fertilised outside the body

watch: Watch for the state's action on private ART centres in the oocyte case.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: As private fertility centres face scrutiny, a government hospital in Hyderabad records three successful IVF deliveries in a week

fact: Gandhi Hospital's government IVF unit delivered *three babies* within one week
twist: Two of the couples had spent lakhs on IVF at private hospitals before; one had waited 16 years.
